text:
sanjay (AP): Uploading BlueRidge invoice — looks like no PO reference. invoice id BlueRidge_INV_4127.pdf attached.
accounts-bot: New invoice uploaded: BlueRidge_INV_4127.pdf (vendor id BR-9901) — parsed amount $18,450.00 — no PO detected.
ellie (Finance Ops): @marcus can you check PO mapping? vendor says this was for 'Q1 model training tokens' — might map to PO-8271 or PO-9134.
marcus (Procurement): Checking. PO-8271 is for "Cloud token commit" to AcmeCloud, not BlueRidge. PO-9134 shows as closed last month.
trevor (Engineering - Platform): BlueRidge did the embedding tuning work for us. I have an email with an SOW referencing internal project "embedops". maybe it's part of PO-8400?
sanjay (AP): The invoice lines list GL 5401 and 5403 split. Some line items have "PO: 8400" in the description but not as a formal PO field — OCR mess.
ellie (Finance Ops): Can you paste the invoice lines here? If it's a partial PO charge we can route as non-PO payment request but needs approver.
trevor (Engineering - Platform): Snip of the invoice text:
```
BlueRidge Analytics
Invoice: 4127
Line 1: Embedding tuning - 100k tokens - $12,000 - Ref: PO 8400/project embedops
Line 2: Support hours - 40h - $6,450 - Tax incl.
```
marcus (Procurement): I ran `po_search --vendor br-9901 --project embedops` and got PO-8400 but it's under legal entity Redwood-EU (GL 5401). This invoice is billed to Redwood-US (GL 5403). That's why it didn't autoplace.
sanjay (AP): Got it — approver routing goes by GL/Entity. Do we want to reclass the invoice to EU so it matches PO-8400 or ask Procurement to move PO ownership to US?
ellie (Finance Ops): Short term: can we get a written approval from the US engineering manager to pay? Long term: need to reconcile PO entity ownership.
trevor (Engineering - Platform): I can get @amrita (Eng Manager US) to approve. amrita — can you confirm these were US deliverables and we should pay from US ledger?
amrita (Engineering Manager): Confirmed delivery for US product line. Approve payment from US ledger. Please include ticket ENG-4567 for traceability.
sanjay (AP): Thanks. For non-PO invoice we'll create a Non-PO Payment Request (NPR) and route to amrita for approval. Can someone confirm vendor tax id and remit address for the NPR?
marcus (Procurement): Vendor tax id BR-TAX-9983 per vendor master. Remit address on invoice matches vendor master.
accounts-bot: NPR created: NPR-6219 for BlueRidge_INV_4127 — routing to amrita (approver), finance-ops, procurement. Link: https://redwood/payments/NPR-6219
ellie (Finance Ops): Quick question — the invoice amount includes VAT line of $450. Do we reclaim VAT for US entity? I think not.
trevor (Engineering - Platform): No reclaim, keep it as expense.
sanjay (AP): I'll queue payment upon amrita approval. @marcus please file an action item to update PO-8400 entity mapping to avoid future mismatches.
marcus (Procurement): Filed ticket PROC-3124 to change PO ownership or create equivalent US PO. ETA 3 business days.
ellie (Finance Ops): Thanks all. @amrita once you approve NPR-6219 note "Charge to ENG-4567 (US)". If we get stuck we can do one-off pay and backdate PO reallocation.
amrita (Engineering Manager): Approved NPR-6219 — "Charge to ENG-4567 (US)". Please proceed.
sanjay (AP): Payment scheduled for next AP run. Marking thread closed. :white_check_mark:
trevor (Engineering - Platform): Thx.
marcus (Procurement): Closing out on procurement side once PROC-3124 done. :+1:
accounts-bot: Payment run executed: NPR-6219 marked paid 2026-03-20 — txn REF 78FQ2.
sanjay (AP): Received remittance confirmation from vendor. Thread resolved"
